criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately applies the operative approved Freight flat rate of $150 from revision 2 (record-17.txt) per the operations document registry (registry.txt), rather than the unapproved $110 draft rate from revision 3 (record-22.txt, working-notes.txt, and Shipping parameters.xlsx). All order details, weights, shipping methods, costs, industry averages, and savings formulas match the source documents without fabricated tracking numbers or arithmetic errors.

criteria.rationale: The spreadsheet fulfills all aspects of the request: it populates the Daily Shipment Manifest template with all three pick tickets (A-1001, B-5005, C-2001), customer names, total weights, weight-based shipping methods (UPS, Freight, Fed Ex), shipment item details, shipment costs, industry average costs, formula-driven savings, and summary totals, while clearly documenting the authority basis and missing tracking numbers.
